pages.siteDescription: Build, validate and share army lists for the Triumph! historical miniature wargame.
pages.armiesDescription: All {count} army lists, searchable by name and keyword and filtered by date range, thematic category, home topography, invasion and manoeuvre rating.
pages.categoriesDescription: The {count} thematic categories Meshwesh sorts its army lists into — a period, a region or a war at a time. An army list belongs to as many as it fought in.
pages.categoryDescription: The Meshwesh army lists filed under the {name} thematic category.
pages.categoryArmies: {count}, searched and filtered the way the index is.
pages.armyDescription: Required troops, contingents and battle cards for the {name} army list, {span}.
pages.buildDescription: Build a {cap}-point {name} army, at a year and a sub-faction of your choosing.
pages.referenceDescription: The {troopTypes} troop types with their costs and combat factors, and the {battleCards} battle cards in full.
pages.troopTypesCard: All {count} troop types, with the cost of a stand, its close and ranged combat factors, its order and what it represents.
pages.troopTypesDescription: All {count} Triumph! troop types: what a stand costs, how it fights in close and ranged combat, whether it is open or close order, and what it represents.
pages.battleCardsCard: All {count} battle cards in full — how each one is selected, what it costs, how it deploys and how it plays.
pages.battleCardsDescription: All {count} Triumph! battle cards in full, as Meshwesh publishes them: how each one is selected, what it costs, how it deploys and how it plays.
pages.rulesDescription: The official Triumph! and Fantasy Triumph documents from the Washington Grand Company.
pages.rulesBookCard: The full rules as a PDF, v1.2, on Wargame Vault.
pages.setupQrsCard: Quick reference sheet for setting up and deploying, as a PDF.
pages.gameplayQrsCard: Quick reference sheet for the turn sequence, movement and combat, as a PDF.
pages.waysToSignInDescription: Every way you can get into this account. Connecting one more means you can use either; you cannot disconnect the last one.
pages.notFoundDescription: That page does not exist. The army you are after may have been renamed or dropped by an upstream data refresh.
pages.renderFailed: This page failed to render. Nothing you have saved is affected — try again, or head back to the army lists.
pages.ogGone: That list is no longer here
pages.ogGoneSubtitle: Build and share army lists for Triumph!
pages.referenceUnavailable: Army lists are not available right now
pages.referenceUnavailableText: This server has no army list data loaded, so there is nothing to show here yet. Nothing you have saved is affected — try again in a few minutes.
pages.fantasyReferenceDescription: Fantasy Triumph plays with the same troop types, some under other names, and buys from its own battle cards.
pages.fantasyTroopTypesCard: All {count} troop types under their Fantasy Triumph names, with the cost of a stand, its combat factors, its movement and its basing.
pages.fantasyTroopTypesDescription: All {count} troop types as Fantasy Triumph names them: what a stand costs, how it fights, how far it moves and how it is based.
pages.fantasyBattleCardsCard: All {count} Fantasy Triumph battle cards — what each one costs, who may take it and how it plays.
pages.fantasyBattleCardsDescription: All {count} Fantasy Triumph battle cards, by what they are bought for: what each one costs, who may take it and how it plays.
pages.triumphReferenceDescription: The historical game: every troop type an army list draws on, and the battle cards Meshwesh publishes.
pages.fantasyRulesBookCard: The Fantasy Triumph supplement as a PDF, Early Access, on Wargame Vault. It needs the Triumph! rules.
pages.fantasyBuildDescription: Build a Fantasy Triumph army of named units, heroes and battle cards, priced and checked as you go.

email.resetSubject: Reset your Triumph! Army Builder password
email.resetPreview: Choose a new password. The link expires in an hour.
email.resetBody: Someone asked to reset the password on your Triumph! Army Builder account. Choose a new one here.
email.resetFooter: The link expires in an hour and works once. If you did not ask for it, ignore this email — your password stays as it is.
email.setSubject: Set a password for Triumph! Army Builder
email.setPreview: Add a password to your account. The link expires in an hour.
email.setBody: Your Triumph! Army Builder account has no password yet: you sign in with a connected account. Choose one here and you can sign in with this address too, and your connected accounts keep working.
email.setFooter: The link expires in an hour and works once. If you did not ask for it, ignore this email — nothing about your account changes.
email.verifySubject: Confirm your Triumph! Army Builder email
email.verifyPreview: Confirm your address. The link expires in an hour.
email.verifyBody: Someone used this address to create a Triumph! Army Builder account. Confirm it here and you are in.
email.verifyFooter: The link expires in an hour and works once. If you did not ask for it, ignore this email — nobody can use the account until the address is confirmed.
email.registeredSubject: You already have a Triumph! Army Builder account
email.registeredPreview: That address is already registered. Sign in instead.
email.registeredBody: Someone just tried to create a Triumph! Army Builder account with this address, and there is already one here. No second account was made and nothing about yours has changed.
email.registeredForgotten: Forgotten the password? <reset>Choose a new one</reset>.
email.registeredFooter: If that was not you, there is nothing to do — knowing an address is registered is all anyone learns from this, and your password is untouched.
email.pasteLink: Or paste this link into your browser:
